newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Pasminco in A$33 mln smelter expansion.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Pasminco in A$33 mln smelter expansion.

text.p: Lead and zinc producer Pasminco Ltd said on Thursday it plans a A$33 million expansion and modernisation of its BHAS smelter at Port Pirie.
The expansion would increase lead production by about 11 percent and more than double silver production, it said.

Pasminco said lead production would increase to 250,000 tonnes a year from 220,000 and silver production to 450 tonnes from 220. The modernisation would also reduce operating costs per tonne, and enable Australian value-adding by refining lead bullion which is currently processed overseas.

It would also allow more flexibility in the smelter's feedstock, improve the smelter's occupational health, safety and environmental performance, and provide up to 80 jobs during the two years of construction.
Work on the initial design phase of the project had begun with work on the construction phase expected to begin in April 1997, the company said.
The work should be completed by October 1998, it said.
Pasminco shares were four cents higher at A$2.12 at 11.45 a.m. (0045 GMT).
